name: Decision usefulness
definition: Users producing a justified next research question / users completing a scenario
measurement_method: Moderator scores output against source coverage and caveats

name: Task completion
definition: Users completing a scenario without moderator help / users attempting it
measurement_method: Observe cuisine location and undecided tasks separately

name: Research time
definition: Median elapsed minutes from entry to exported comparison plus research question
target: Proposed <=5 minutes; compare with manual baseline
measurement_method: Same tasks and time rule for manual and prototype conditions

name: Data integrity
definition: Passed deterministic build checks / executed build checks

name: Traceable requirements
definition: Essential requirements with feature and acceptance criterion / all essential requirements

name: Evidence coverage
definition: Modules showing source period units and scope / analytical modules
measurement_method: Supply maps rent delivery market-context review
